subtopics.title: Quick-Fire Recall: Objective Questions Under the Clock

questions.question: Money entering the circular flow through investment, government spending and exports is known as:
Give-the-term items refuse abbreviations, so the correct answer for 'the fraction of each extra rand of income that households spend' is:
options: The marginal propensity to consume, written out in full

questions.question: An increase in a currency's value under a FLOATING exchange rate system is called:
The economists who blame business cycles on shocks from OUTSIDE the market system are the:

subtopics.title: Short Answers: Banking the Easy Marks First

questions.question: Name TWO instruments of fiscal policy. A full-mark pair is:
options: The repo rate and moral suasion
Open market transactions and cash reserves

questions.question: What effect will an appreciation of the rand have on imports? The two-mark answer is:
options: Imports become cheaper in rand terms, so import volumes rise

questions.question: A sudden rise in household saving slows the economy in the short run because:
options: Saving is an injection into the circular flow
Saving is a leakage — money withdrawn from the spending stream, so sales and production fall

subtopics.title: Data Response: Reading a Business Cycle Diagram

questions.question: On the cycle diagram, point P at the crest of the wave is the:
Extrapolation on a business cycle diagram means:
options: Extending the established trend beyond the present to predict where the economy is heading
Measuring the depth of the trough

questions.question: Distance L between two successive crests measures:
options: The length of the cycle — the time from one peak to the next

questions.question: Stimulus policy is most expected at point R, the trough, because:
options: Government always cuts spending at the trough
Activity has fallen as far as it will, so stimulus there supports the recovery rather than feeding a boom

subtopics.title: Data Response: A Balance of Payments Table

questions.question: In the table, the profits of a South African bank's London branch sent home appear under:
Goods exports 950, net gold exports 150, merchandise imports 1 250. The trade balance is:
With total receipts of 1 500, total payments of 1 650 and net transfers of plus 30, the current account balance is:
options: Minus 120 million — a current account deficit

questions.question: A valid response to a current account deficit is:
options: Lowering interest rates to push capital out
Fixing the rand permanently to the dollar
Raising interest rates to draw in foreign capital and promoting exports to grow receipts

subtopics.title: Paragraph Answers: Explaining and Arguing for Marks

questions.question: A ten-mark paragraph answer in this practice set is built from:
options: Five developed facts at two marks each, or a described graph standing in for one of them

questions.question: If households spend three quarters of each extra rand, the multiplier is:
options: Four — one divided by the quarter that is not spent

questions.question: On the multiplier graph, equilibrium income moves by MORE than the injection because:
options: Each round of new spending becomes income that is largely spent again

questions.question: In an arguing paragraph on the weaker rand, the mark that lifts a list into an argument is:
options: The weighing sentence — a judgement on when the gains outweigh the costs

subtopics.title: The Essay, Built Live: Smoothing of Business Cycles

questions.question: The mark plan of this session's thirty-mark practice essay is:
options: Definition 2, main body 20, evaluation 6, closing judgement 2

questions.question: To smooth a DOWNSWING, the correct policy pairing is:
options: Raise the repo rate and raise taxes
Cut the repo rate, lift government spending and trim taxes

questions.question: Automatic stabilisers smooth the cycle because:
options: The central bank adjusts them monthly
They require a new budget each time
Progressive taxes and grants adjust with income on their own, without any new decision

questions.question: A strong six-mark evaluation of demand-side smoothing would argue that:
options: Lags, the inflation trade-off, supply shocks and debt costs all limit smoothing — so it works best beside supply-side reform

subtopics.title: A Second Essay Plan and Final Exam Wisdom

questions.question: The trade policy that pushes local producers into world markets with incentives and marketing support is:
The classic danger of import substitution is that:
options: Sheltered industries stay expensive and inefficient behind their tariff walls

questions.question: The command verb 'evaluate' requires you to:
options: Give a substantiated judgement of your own on strengths and weaknesses

questions.question: When a question set offers choices, the smart criterion is:
options: Avoid any question with a table
Choose by the data you read best — data questions and paragraphs carry the weight of the marks
